plugin_desc: NTI ENVIROMUX SNMP collection for environmental monitors under NTI PEN 3699. The shared SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic. This child template adds internal temperature and humidity from the 16D scalars plus the MICRO internal sensor table. Shared CPU, memory, fan and power-health scalars are not claimed.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: network_service_nti_temperature
metrics.description: ENVIROMUX internal temperature from the 16D scalar, coalesced with MICRO sensor-table rows whose type is temperature.

metrics.name: network_service_nti_humidity
metrics.description: ENVIROMUX internal relative humidity from the 16D scalar, coalesced with MICRO sensor-table rows whose type is humidity.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Device uptime since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime.
